vetSays.line: A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +4 clean.
🍲 A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek eats with A man, maybe 30s — bowls side by side, talk low.

"Hey." A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek.)
A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin." The pantry won't fill itself.
A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)

A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going." The pantry won't fill itself.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village.
